# bioexcel/biobb_pytorch/feat2traj

## Summary

Converts a .pt file (features) to a trajectory using cartesian indices and topology from the stats file.

Converts a .pt file (features) to a trajectory using cartesian indices and topology from the stats file.

Nextflow adapter of the [Feat2Traj](https://biobb-pytorch.readthedocs.io/en/latest/mdae.html#module-biobb_pytorch.mdae.feat2traj) building block of [biobb_pytorch](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_pytorch) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_PYTORCH_FEAT2TRAJ } from 'bioexcel/biobb_pytorch/feat2traj'

workflow {
    BIOBB_PYTORCH_FEAT2TRAJ(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_results_npz_path` | yes | npz | Path to the input reconstructed results file (.npz), typically containing an 'xhat' array |
| `input_stats_pt_path` | yes | pt | Path to the input model statistics file (.pt) containing cartesian indices and optionally topology |
| `input_topology_path` | no | pdb | Path to the topology file (PDB) used if no suitable topology is found in the stats file. Used if no topology is found in stats |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_traj_path` | yes | xtc, pdb, dcd | Path to save the trajectory in xtc/pdb/dcd format |
| `output_top_path` | no, opt-in | pdb | Path to save the output topology file (pdb). Used if trajectory format requires separate topology |
| `versions_biobb_pytorch` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_pytorch', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Feat2Traj properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_top_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_pytorch container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_PYTORCH_FEAT2TRAJ' {
        ext.properties = []
    }
}
```
